name: Helix Trainer
tagline: Keybinding trainer for the Helix editor with spaced repetition
description: Helix Trainer is a Rust-based trainer for learning Helix editor keybindings. It uses FSRS spaced repetition to schedule practice so bindings move into long-term memory, and it wraps that in arcade and survival modes to keep drilling engaging. It ships with 134 scenarios covering the editor's modal workflow, and it runs 100 percent offline. For anyone investing in the Helix modal model, it turns the dreaded learning curve into a structured, game-like path.
highlights: FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling for long-term retention
Arcade and survival modes keep keybinding drills engaging
curatorNote: Helix's modal model is powerful but has a genuinely steep learning curve. Wrapping it in FSRS spaced repetition plus arcade modes is the most thoughtful way yet to make that investment painless.
